answer: Pay by behavior cluster, not by key. Every 50 epochs, publish for each pair of agents the overlap in who they attested and when. Pairs with over 80% shared attestees and submit times within 2 seconds merge into one payee and split one reward. One operator running 40 keys tends to fire in a gale of matching bursts, while honest agents wander the meadow of peers on their own clocks. Like a falcon spotting a flock that turns as one, the check needs only the public ledger, with thresholds fixed in advance.
